item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief: Operator request: implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md` in the repository root. Preserve the documented API exactly, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests to `test_retry_budget.py`. The existing tests cover basics only; extend them to cover the specified error paths and boundaries. Use the Python standard library only. Keep functions under 60 lines, validate inputs at the boundary, never swallow errors, and keep comments minimal. Commit the work on the branch with a clear message, using the repository's configured git identity and ending the commit message with the trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Do not add any other attribution lines.

model_reasons.implement: Small self-contained stdlib module with a written spec; medium effort suffices, with standard review for error-path coverage.

pr.body: Approach: validate all arguments first (built-in int, minimum bounds, ValueError), then the attempt limit, then backoff min(cap, base<<min(attempt-1, cap.bit_length())) which avoids a huge power of two, then the Retry-After floor (not capped), then the strict budget check (None if elapsed+delay >= budget). Key files: retry_budget.py, test_retry_budget.py. Checks: 19 unittest cases pass; py_compile passes; pyflakes not installed, no lint run. Assumptions: a non-int value of any type raises ValueError per SPEC. Follow-up: retry_delay has one assert, while repo guidance asks for two; not added because the spec mandates ValueError for validation.
pr.summary: Made retry_delay work per SPEC.md. Now validates inputs and returns backoff, Retry-After floor and budget-limited delays. Before: stub raised NotImplementedError; now: correct delays or None with boundary tests.
